name: ncas
description: n-CAS — Student Classroom Attendance System (IGCSE Computer Science coursework prototype)

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of ['.next','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}console.log('removed .next and tsconfig.tsbuildinfo')"
scripts.clean:all: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of ['.next','node_modules','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}console.log('removed .next, node_modules and tsconfig.tsbuildinfo — run npm install to restore')"
